description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller 'GlobalErrorController' that handles application errors routed to '/error'. It returns a JSON response with error details such as timestamp, status, error message, and request path, thus replacing default error pages with JSON payloads for better client handling.

classes.name: GlobalErrorController
classes.description: A REST controller implementing ErrorController to catch all errors at '/error' and respond with JSON containing error details.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors redirected to '/error' by extracting status, request URI, message, and exception info from the HttpServletRequest. Constructs a JSON body with timestamp, status, error message, and path. Returns ResponseEntity with JSON body and appropriate HTTP status.
